# Font Awesome -> Material Symbols (Odoo 20)

From `odoo/upgrade_code/material_symbols_icons_mapping.py` (792 entries). Use as `<i class="oi" data-icon="NAME"/>` (add `oi-filled` when the filled column says yes). "Shipped" = present in the font subset (`addons/web/tooling/icons/icons_wishlist.txt`, 484 icons; `oi_*` brand glyphs come from the separate `web.odoo_ui_icons` font): an icon outside both renders no glyph.
